title: Introduce weighted-span-sampler and token exposure map for per-tenant observability
author: Maya Patel
commits: a1f7b9c: add initial weighted-span-sampler implementation and unit tests
b2c8d4e: add token exposure aggregator (Go) and proto definitions
c3d9e5f: dashboard JSON and example queries for token exposure map
d4e0f6a: alert rules and CI integration test for sampler stability
e5f1a7b: docs, examples, and minor lint fixes
description:
Motivation: our current sampled-span coverage misses high-cost, mid-frequency invocation patterns that drive long-tail billing spikes. This PR introduces a lightweight weighted-span-sampler plus a token exposure map aggregator. The sampler biases sampling probability by a configurable weight computed from token-cost, latency anomaly score, and error-rate — allowing us to capture more signal from financially important invocations without increasing overall sampling volume. The token exposure map aggregates digest-level token and latency distributions per tenant/model/route/prompt-shape (shape = prefix length + top-k length bucket), producing a compact heatmap used by dashboards and alerting.

This is an end-to-end change: sampler in Python runtime path, aggregator in Go for the telemetry pipeline, dashboard JSON for quick visualization, and an alert rule set to reduce noisy alerts while surfacing real cost regressions. The description below is a single continuous string. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-4923) [x] unit tests added for sampler behavior [x] integration test against a small synthetic replay [x] dashboard and example queries [x] docs and runbook for SRE.

Key behaviors: the sampler exposes a 3-tier weight composition (token_cost_weight, latency_anomaly_weight, error_weight) and a global budget so expected sampled rate is stable across tenants. We use reservoir sampling with exponential decay windows to avoid bursty over-sampling. The aggregator produces weekly rollups and a near-real-time 1m index for the dashboard.

Backward compatibility & rollout: sampler is behind runtime flag sampling.experimental.weighted_span_sampler and defaults to off. Aggregator supports both new compressed ingestion and fallback to existing uncompressed schema; config toggles allow progressive enabling per telemetry cluster. Release plan in docs/token-exposure.md.

Related: SUP-1284 (customer reported unexplained token-cost drift), ENG-5021 (dashboard task), several observability infra tickets.
review_comments: Owen Brooks (reviewer): The weighted formula looks reasonable, but we need clarity on how tenant-level budgets are enforced when multiple weight signals spike at once. Can we add a circuit that scales down weights deterministically?

Maya Patel (author reply): Added deterministic budget clamp and documented the scaling function in weighted_span_sampler.py. The unit tests include a stress scenario (see test_weighted_sampler.py::test_budget_clamp).

Sofia Martins (reviewer): The Go aggregator reads proto streams — can this cause a CPU hotspot if every aggregator tries to decode heavy payloads? Suggest adding a lightweight header-only index to short-circuit full decode for low-cardinality queries.
Maya Patel (author reply): Implemented header-only indexing for the common query path; full decode remains available. Added microbenchmarks and included results in the PR description.

merge: squash and merge by Owen Brooks after CI green and two approvals
release_notes: Add weighted span sampler to prioritize cost/latency/error correlated traces; add token exposure map and dashboard to visualize per-tenant token and latency exposure. Rollout behind runtime flag; docs include runbook and upgrade guidance.
